sign: No bottom has been found. Three surveyors went looking. The water kept their notes.
surveyor: Mordaunt: Fourth surveyor sent to find the bottom. The first three left me their rope. It was short.
surveyor_intro: Mordaunt: You look heavy enough to sound the depth. Hold still.
surveyor_defeat: Mordaunt: Fine. I'll write 'deep' and go home.
